title: Record byte retention of the eight selected-frontier source pulls
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Overlap receipt for the eight pull requests named first in `certificates/selected-result.json` `source_prs`. No new κ and no ledger edit. The selected conditional exponent remains `605457647/200000000000`.

On main `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`, each recorded head is an ancestor. Every `research/` integration path in those ledger rows is byte-identical to its pull-request head. The 1,245-file selected execution closure matches this tree. Its three roots are the incorporated pulls #5407, #5413 and #5414.

#5398, #5400 and #5402 stay `partially_reviewed`. Their research trees are fully retained and the selected record names them, but they are not in the execution closure. The #5398 and #5400 rows still say archival publication does not admit an improved κ. The #5413 promotion says the final `+5×10^-12` over those two pulls is compiler/outer headroom. This receipt keeps both sentences and does not reclassify the rows.

#4610 and #5241 research trees match their heads. `certificates/selected-result.json` has changed since those heads, and `docs/research/pr-intake-evidence/pr4610/PROOF-REVIEW.md` was added later. All eight GitHub closures are `merged_for_archive_only`.

This is a scoped retention receipt. It is not a replay of the frontier, a scientific acceptance of the partially reviewed rows, or a multiplication theorem.

## Task and overlap

Base `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`. Card `overlap-receipt`, priority revision 7, scope **refined**.

Session r38, item 6 of the ordered eligible list in `research/frontier-source-retention/README.md`. Items 1–5 are the `(w, q, v_N)` caller, the L561 placement cost, the `BIT.md` weighted-leaf routes, the R437 blank-return visit count, and `coverage-law-change` on the current selection.

Nearest records: the ledger rows for these eight pulls, `docs/research/pr-intake-evidence/pr5413-promotion/PROMOTION.md`, and `docs/research/community-neutral5413-contributors.md`. No open pull request already states this eight-row byte table.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -B research/frontier-source-retention/verify.py
python3 -O -B research/frontier-source-retention/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/frontier-source-retention
```

Normal, optimized and registered replay all print `PASS_FRONTIER_SOURCE_RETENTION prs=8 identical_paths=26 manifest_files=1245 partial_but_named=5398,5400,5402 certificate_moved_after=4610,5241 no_ledger_edit=true no_new_kappa=true`. Metadata replay prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/frontier-source-retention outcome=partial`.

The checker hashes every manifest path, compares each integration path with `git diff` under `GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1`, and rejects a forged `incorporated` label on #5398 and a one-path manifest mismatch.

Not run: `make frontier5413-verify`, Lean, Docker, and any edit of the ledger.

## Credit

Ledger, promotion and contributor text retain Chris R / Clear1nsight (#5398, #5400, #5407, #5413, #5414, #5241), Dillon Amburgey / dillona (#5402) and Cao Yifan / intqwq (#4610), with the lineages those records already name.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance.

## Open next questions

1. Should the #5398 and #5400 rows stay partially reviewed after the #5413 promotion? Their unresolved sentence still denies an improved κ, while the promotion uses them as the base of a `5×10^-12` headroom term. The first step is to quote those two sentences together. This package does not edit the ledger.
2. Which fields of `certificates/selected-result.json` changed after the #4610 head `20bb93cd990d2ff683e4d0fc56b87a42cd5d3296`? The receipt only shows that the file differs.
